newsitem.title: USA: ITI Technologies sees Q4 EPS about $0.42.
newsitem.headline: ITI Technologies sees Q4 EPS about $0.42.

text.p: ITI Technologies Inc said Friday it expects to report fourth-quarter earnings of $0.42 a share in the fourth quarter.
The company reported earnings of $0.37 a share in the year ago quarter.

ITI also said it expects to report fourth quarter revenues of about $23.5 million, a 10 percent increase over the fourth quarter of 1995, resulting in record year-end 1996 revenues of about $93.3 million, up 18 percent from 1995.

ITI also announced that it has received purchase orders from ADT Ltd's ADT Security for about $20.3 million of wireless security products to be delivered during 1997. ITI anticipates shipping to ADT at least $13.7 million of such products during the period beginning January 1997 and ending May 1997 and the balance during the period beginning June 1997 and ending August 1997, ITI said.

ITI said on November 15, 1996, that it received a letter from ADT stating that ITI should "anticipate a reduction in purchase orders from ADT during the first quarter of 1997..." ADT has now informed ITI that a transition to an alternative product source will not be completed until September of 1997, ITI said.
This development will significantly better ITI's 1997 revenue outlook as compared to analysts' estimates made shortly after the original ADT announcement, ITI said.
ITI also said it repurchased 621,500 share of its common stock in December under a 900,000 share repurchase plan.
